title: Calimocho engine release index envelope, version 1
description: DSSE v1 envelope (https://github.com/secure-systems-lab/dsse) around a calimocho-engine-index/1 payload. Each signature is Ed25519 (RFC 8032) over PAE(payloadType, payload bytes) = "DSSEv1" SP LEN(payloadType) SP payloadType SP LEN(payload) SP payload, where LEN is the byte length in ASCII decimal without leading zeros and SP is one space (0x20). keyid is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the raw 32-byte public key. Clients ignore signatures whose keyid they do not trust and accept the envelope only if at least one trusted signature verifies.

payload.description: Standard base64 (RFC 4648 section 4, with padding) of the UTF-8 payload JSON bytes. The payload is at most 1 MiB.

sig.description: Standard base64 of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature.
